name: Numerical Weather Prediction Field Request Builder Nodes
description: Request-builder flow nodes for numerical-weather-prediction model fields in NOAA Open Data Dissemination's anonymous public buckets (NCEP GFS noaa-gfs-bdp-pds, GEFS noaa-gefs-pds), fetched message by message through each file's .idx inventory (typed contracts 1.0: FlatBuffers only, no JSON and no base64). plan turns a TimerTick into the run's inventory HttpRequests, product by product and lead by lead, 16 per invocation, the rest yielded as backlog; select_messages reads the inventories' HttpResponses and emits each lead-file's wanted messages as byte-range HttpRequests (adjacent ones merged, each under 64 MiB), ONE LEAD-FILE (at most 16 ranges) PER INVOCATION, the rest yielded as backlog, so the parser holds one file's messages and storage-ingest receives one meta and one record stream at a time; publish_request turns a stored batch's IngestResult plus the parser's IngestRequest into the dataset-publication POST, its body the IngestResult naming the batch (nothing when nwp_publish_url is unset or the batch was refused). JOB STATE TRAVELS AS HttpRequest.CONTEXT: one size-prefixed $WXF header record per (product, lead), built by plan, echoed by hostcap/http-request, copied verbatim into every range request by select_messages and read by nwp-grib2-parser as its job; pairing is by CONTEXT, never by position. Products are the world-clouds display's, chosen as its reference fetchers choose them: gfs-1p00-motion (winds and, early, heights at 1000-200 hPa), gefs-0p50-spread (the ensemble wind spread at every other point), gfs-0p50-clouds (instantaneous cloud cover, total and by layer, and the 2 m temperature and dew point, 10 m wind, boundary-layer height, CAPE and surface height the 1 deg world-clouds kernel samples), gfs-0p25-physics (2 m temperature/dew point, 10 m wind, boundary-layer height, CAPE, surface height, cloud layers, and the 21-level + tropopause profiles), gfs-0p25-sea (the surface weather, cut by the parser into 11.25 deg tiles). Every request sets If-Modified-Since at the epoch so the host never turns a repeat inventory or range into an empty 304. Node CONFIG through plugin.getConfig (SDS $PIV, one ModuleConfig on raw "config"): nwp_live_access, nwp_run, nwp_products, nwp_max_lead, nwp_lead_step, nwp_motion_heights_to, nwp_physics_leads, timeouts, nwp_publish_url. No credentials: capabilities none.

sequentialJustification.detail: Each method turns its typed frames into request frames in one pass: plan reads the node config once and queues one inventory request per lead-file, select_messages parses the inventories and queues one entry per lead-file, publish_request pairs one result with one meta. The only state is the two queues, drained a batch per invocation as the compiled runtime resumes the yielded node; no worker pool and no thread.

methods.description: TimerTick -> the run's .idx inventory HttpRequests, one per (product, lead), each carrying its job ($WXF header) in CONTEXT; 16 per invocation, the rest yielded as backlog and resumed without input. A FlowNotice when live access is off (Skipped) or the run is already planned (Unchanged). One tick per invocation (a surplus is refused as batched-input-frames); its fields are not read.

acceptedTypeSets.description: TimerTick (module-sdk runtime type TICK) from the flow's timer trigger.

inputPorts.description: Cron timer tick (fields not read: any tick plans).

acceptedTypeSets.description: HttpRequest (HREQ) for hostcap/http-request: GET <file>.idx, if-modified-since at the epoch, TIMEOUT_MS nwp_idx_timeout_ms; CONTEXT: the job, one size-prefixed $WXF header record (no values) naming the field the job fetches - FIELD_ID <model_key>:<run>:f<LLL>:<product>, VARIABLE_NAME the product, MODEL_CLASS/MODEL_ID, INIT_TIME_MS/LEAD_HOURS/VALID_TIME_MS, MEMBER_KIND/ENSEMBLE_SIZE, GRID (DLAT/DLON the records' spacing, NLAT the rows a record, 0 = whole), TILE_COUNT (>1: square tiles), SOURCE_URL the GRIB2 file and its attribution (ORIGIN_ID, DATASET_ID, LICENSE_CLASS, LICENSE_URL, CITATION).

FlowNotice (module-sdk runtime type FNTC): Skipped (REASON live-access-disabled / nothing-to-fetch), Unchanged (REASON already-planned, or inventory-304 with COUNT), Missing (REASON missing-leads, ITEMS the inventories the run lacks with their HTTP status, or the lead-files with no wanted message).

methods.description: The inventories' HttpResponses (each carrying its job header in CONTEXT) -> each lead-file's wanted messages (instantaneous fields of the product's variables and levels) as Range GETs, adjacent messages merged, each under 64 MiB, the job header copied into each. One lead-file (at most 16 ranges) per invocation; the node yields with the rest as backlog and the runtime resumes it without input. A lead the run lacks is a FlowNotice Missing, inventories answered 304 a FlowNotice Unchanged; a response without a $WXF job header cannot be attributed and is refused (missing-context).

acceptedTypeSets.description: HttpResponse (HRSP) from hostcap/http-request: STATUS, BODY the GRIB2 .idx inventory text, CONTEXT the job header plan sent.

inputPorts.description: One inventory response per plan request, in any order (paired by CONTEXT).

acceptedTypeSets.description: HttpRequest (HREQ) for hostcap/http-request: GET <file>, range bytes=a-b, if-modified-since at the epoch, TIMEOUT_MS nwp_grib_timeout_ms; CONTEXT: the job, one size-prefixed $WXF header record (no values) naming the field the job fetches - FIELD_ID <model_key>:<run>:f<LLL>:<product>, VARIABLE_NAME the product, MODEL_CLASS/MODEL_ID, INIT_TIME_MS/LEAD_HOURS/VALID_TIME_MS, MEMBER_KIND/ENSEMBLE_SIZE, GRID (DLAT/DLON the records' spacing, NLAT the rows a record, 0 = whole), TILE_COUNT (>1: square tiles), SOURCE_URL the GRIB2 file and its attribution (ORIGIN_ID, DATASET_ID, LICENSE_CLASS, LICENSE_URL, CITATION) (the inventory's, verbatim).

outputPorts.description: The Range GET(s) of one lead-file.

acceptedTypeSets.description: FlowNotice (module-sdk runtime type FNTC): Skipped (REASON live-access-disabled / nothing-to-fetch), Unchanged (REASON already-planned, or inventory-304 with COUNT), Missing (REASON missing-leads, ITEMS the inventories the run lacks with their HTTP status, or the lead-files with no wanted message).

outputPorts.description: Which files the run lacks, or that the inventories were unchanged.

methods.description: A stored batch's IngestResult + the parser's IngestRequest -> one dataset-publication POST to nwp_publish_url whose BODY is an IngestResult (INGR) naming the batch (SCHEMA, PROVIDER_ID, SOURCE_NAME, BATCH_ID, counts); nothing when nwp_publish_url is unset or the result is REFUSED. One pair per invocation.

acceptedTypeSets.description: IngestResult (module-sdk runtime type INGR) from hostcap/storage-ingest.
IngestRequest (module-sdk runtime type INGQ) the parser authored for the batch (SCHEMA, TAGS provider/source/batch).
HttpRequest (HREQ) for hostcap/http-request: POST nwp_publish_url, content-type application/octet-stream, BODY one IngestResult (INGR) FlatBuffer naming the stored batch.
